sourceChecks.text: The king said also to Zadok the priest, “Aren’t you a seer? Return into the city in peace, and your two sons with you, Ahimaaz your son and Jonathan the son of Abiathar.
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 2SA15:27で本文がヨナタンを名指す。

sourceChecks.text: Behold, they have there with them their two sons, Ahimaaz, Zadok’s son, and Jonathan, Abiathar’s son. Send to me everything that you shall hear by them.”
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 2SA15:36で本文がヨナタンを名指す。

sourceChecks.text: Now Jonathan and Ahimaaz were staying by En Rogel; and a female servant used to go and report to them, and they went and told King David; for they couldn’t risk being seen coming into the city.
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 2SA17:17で本文がヨナタンを名指す。

sourceChecks.text: Absalom’s servants came to the woman to the house; and they said, “Where are Ahimaaz and Jonathan?” The woman said to them, “They have gone over the brook of water.” When they had sought and could not find them, they returned to Jerusalem.
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 17:20で追跡者に居場所を問われた件を含め、井戸に隠れた経過を裏づける。
